verdict.rationale: Vue documents major-version migrations (v2→v3 migration guide) and a formal EOL/security-update policy for Vue 2, showing some commitment to a versioning and deprecation lifecycle, but there's no evidence of a broader documented API versioning/deprecation policy for the core JS API surface (e.g., semver deprecation notices per minor release) beyond the major-version transition. missing for 10: granular per-API deprecation notices, formal semver deprecation policy documentation, machine-readable changelog/versioning spec.
